facts.fact: 失眠整夜，清晨六点就爬起备战「一生一次的约会」。
facts.anchor: the clock on my phone finally reached 6 a.m.

facts.fact: 她像过圣诞一样蹑手蹑脚出房——只是「礼物」Finlay 没系着缎带在隔壁等她。
facts.anchor: I still had a while to wait before I could unwrap my gift. Finlay Munro wasn’t waiting for me in another room with a ribbon around his waist.

facts.fact: 独居恐惧的具体化：吃着止痛药睡去、死在梦里——都没人知道。
facts.anchor: I could have a headache and go to bed after taking a few painkillers and die in my sleep. Either way, inside or out, I’d just be left here, forgotten.

facts.fact: 曾经的「狐红鬃毛」如今成了番茄酱洗碗水色。
facts.anchor: Now, it resembles dirty tomato ketchup dishwater

facts.fact: 刷牙刷到吐血、洗四遍头、两把剃刀脱毛——她宣布自己「重生」。
facts.anchor: I considered myself reborn after shedding my fuzz like a snake does its skin

facts.fact: 蛰居不是计划是滑落：一切可快递，只有倒垃圾日才下到街口。
facts.anchor: I didn’t plan on isolating myself from the outside world. It just sort of happened

facts.fact: 出门前给 Luna 的碗里加满猫粮「以防今晚太尽兴、回来得晚」。
facts.anchor: I fill her bowl to the brim with biscuits too – just in case tonight goes really well and I don’t make it back until late.

facts.fact: 开锁瞬间右耳尖鸣，那声音吼「RUN」——她回一句「知道了老天」，照样拉开大门。
facts.anchor: ‘RUN,’ a voice hollers. It’s not Nova, but the same one from before, the one I’ve only started hearing recently.
